data.value: Borderless window without title bar; common for multi-monitor setups. Game settings also have a global toggle that appends this at launch.

data.value: Request exclusive fullscreen (-window-mode exclusive). Support varies by game/Unity version.

data.name: CmdArg_WindowModeBorderless_Desc
data.value: Request borderless fullscreen (-window-mode borderless). Support varies by game/Unity version.

data.name: CmdArg_ForceD3D11_Desc
data.value: Force the D3D11 graphics API; useful when DX12 causes issues.

data.name: CmdArg_ForceD3D12_Desc
data.value: Request D3D12 (-use-d3d12). Enabling DX12 in app settings also appends this automatically.

data.name: CmdArg_ForceVulkan_Desc
data.value: Force the Vulkan graphics API. May not be supported by all miHoYo PC clients.

data.name: CmdArg_ForceLowPowerDevice_Desc
data.value: Prefer integrated/low-power GPU (-force-low-power-device); helpful on hybrid-GPU laptops.

data.name: CmdArg_ForceGfxDirect_Desc
data.value: Disable multi-threaded rendering (-force-gfx-direct); can help with some GPU driver issues.

data.name: CmdArg_NoLog_Desc
data.value: Do not write the Unity player log (-nolog).

data.value: Run the One-Dragon workflow. Optionally enter a profile name (BetterGI 0.45.3+); leave empty to use the one currently selected in BetterGI.

data.value: Run scheduler config groups in order. Enter names separated by spaces; they must match BetterGI exactly.

data.value: Run scheduler groups from task progress. Enter names separated by spaces; they must match BetterGI exactly.

data.value: Close the game when OneDragon finishes.

data.name: CmdArg_OneDragon_Shutdown_Desc
data.value: Shut down the PC when OneDragon finishes. Seconds are optional (default 60).

data.value: Select OneDragon's own account instances (comma-separated, e.g. 1,2). Which account logs into the game is decided by those instances. Moonward does not inject a login ticket when a custom launcher is used, so its "Login account" setting has no effect here.
